name: value-arms-dev
decision: Jerry 2026-11-10: 'Sounds good yes let's screen some of these even if they don't pass offline bar'. This overrides experiments/value-arms.json on_fail ('no screen for that arm') for the value-arms candidates; all t-arms passed offline (board #1 comments 6783474189, 6783815428).

candidates.t9: planner_pv2_tiles_va_t9: served size trained from scratch on original + on-policy data (offline: +.0027 / +.0055 AUC)
candidates.t8: planner_pv2_tiles_va_t8: warm start from served, original + on-policy (offline: +.0006 / +.0034 AUC, best cross-eval pick)

not_screened.t7: 3.2M params: weakest offline of the capacity arms and not servable by the NumPy server at its size

later: s1 / s2 may be added by their own table files under this umbrella before any of their games run (same seeds, same gate).
bundle: each candidate also carries the planner_pv2_tiles_buyfix purchase scoring (owner decision, board #1 comment 6756308802); a pass supports the bundle, not the weights alone

tables.self_served: experiments/value-arms-self-screen-<arm>.json (evaluator; 400 seeds 3080000+, shared by all candidates; three planner_pv2_tiles opponents)
tables.jsettlers: experiments/jsettlers-va-dev-<arm>.json (Mac mini; 1024 games, base 20261119; the tiles run is the shared control)

gate: Per candidate, PASS iff both: (1) self_served point lift >= +.02 with the evaluator's gates; (2) JSettlers scripts/jsettlers_paired.py --point-bar 0.02 'dev_pass' against the shared control. Candidates are judged separately; the DEV is a screen, so the held-out (fresh seeds, sized from the DEV point, variance_floor .10, >= 512 seeds; 2048 paired JSettlers games) is the confirmatory step for any passer.
power: per candidate as exact-dev2: .945 x .861 = .814 at a true +.04 on both tables
note: Predeclared 2026-11-10 before any game of these candidates.
